text:
jamie: hi team, first day! trying to get python/node/go/rust working on an Intel MBP. asdf python keeps failing during compile with missing openssl symbols. i have brew installed but i think i used the wrong prefix years ago and have bits in /opt/homebrew and /usr/local. any quick robust fix?

devex: welcome jamie :wave: messy prefixes are common. two options i use: 1) point python build to brew openssl via env vars, or 2) use PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS to tell configure where openssl is. example that tends to work even with mixed prefixes:

```
brew install openssl@1.1 pkg-config
export BREW_OPENSSL_DIR=$(brew --prefix openssl@1.1)
export CFLAGS="-I${BREW_OPENSSL_DIR}/include"
export LDFLAGS="-L${BREW_OPENSSL_DIR}/lib"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="${BREW_OPENSSL_DIR}/lib/pkgconfig"
export PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--enable-optimizations --with-openssl=${BREW_OPENSSL_DIR}"
asdf plugin-add python || true
asdf install python 3.11.5
```

that PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS helps the build system find the right libraries even if you have leftovers elsewhere.

riley: also make sure Xcode CLT installed (`xcode-select --install`) and that pkg-config is on PATH. for nodejs, the asdf-nodejs plugin requires gpg; `brew install gpg` then follow the plugin instructions to import release keys.

jamie: nice, thanks! how do people manage .tool-versions and dotfiles here? i prefer checking in repo pins but keep machine-level pins separate.

devex: same pattern: repo-level .tool-versions committed, and keep a local-only file for laptop pins (e.g. `~/.tool-versions-local` in your dotfiles and add it to .gitignore). we recommend using chezmoi or plain symlinks for dotfiles. put `eval "$(asdf init -)"` in your shell rc and use direnv for project envs.

riley: for env vars and secrets, use direnv + 1password integration. don't store API keys in dotfiles. ask devex for access to the "Redwood - Developer Secrets" vault. common local vars: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ENV=development, REDWOOD_REGION.

onboard-bot: reminder: new hires should request 1Password vault access if not already granted.

jamie: build worked after PYTHON_CONFIGURE_OPTS trick, thanks. next up node + yarn. will ping if i hit more weird prefix issues. :thumbsup:
